description: Search Convertlyft’s public documentation for agents — https://convertlyft.com/llms.txt and https://convertlyft.com/llms-full.txt (the API, the MCP door, dates, limits, worked examples). Returns the best-matching sections, quoted, each with where it came from. Plain word matching, not a summary. No account needed; same per-address limits as the other public tools.

fields.description: Top-level keys to keep, e.g. ["kpis"] — envelope keys, not metric names. See the server instructions.

query.description: What to look for, like "rate limit" or "connect Claude".

evidence.description: Where the figures came from (measured, indexed or modelled): counted, read from stored rows, or estimated.
